Ria Patel: Heads-up — billing ping: our committed GPU reservations in us-west-2 show an expiry window ~18 days out. Need quick triage: which reservations do we keep, which do we let lapse, and any swap-to-savings-plan moves?
Sam Turner: Can you paste the list Ria? I can run a utilization diff against tag owners.
Ria Patel: pasted below from the billing export (sanitized):
```
reservation_id: r-0a1b2c3d4e
instance_type: p4d.24xlarge
region: us-west-2
start: 2022-08-01
end: 2026-04-05
committed_vCPU: 960
committed_GPU: 64
avg_util_pct_90d: 42
```
```
reservation_id: r-9z8y7x6w5v
instance_type: p3dn.24xlarge
region: us-west-2
end: 2026-04-10
avg_util_pct_90d: 18
notes: mostly training batch jobs (spiky)
```
Sam Turner: Thanks. From quick scan: p4d pool looks partially used (40-50% typical), p3dn is very low recent utilization. 2 ideas: 1) keep p4d but reduce reservation count at next renewal window; 2) let p3dn lapse and rely on spot/on-demand for burst training.
Jihoon Kim: Agree. Also we should consider a convertible reservation swap for the p4d if savings are meaningful — or migrate workload to G4-Flex v2 compute on cheaper SKUs with batching. Need perf validation.
Elena Gomez: Ops question: any services pinned to reservation IDs for compliance? I saw a tag mismatch in the inventory — some reservations are untagged and show as "shared". If we cancel them we could break cost attribution.
Ria Patel: Good call. I'll run a tag reconciliation job today. Sam — can you produce a by-owner utilization table by EOD? Even coarse buckets (keep/monitor/cancel) is fine.
Sam Turner: On it. I'll run `python tools/reservation_util.py --region us-west-2 --group-by owner --days 90` and push results to #cost-ops. Expect results in ~3h.
CostBot: Automated alert: projected quarterly committed spend delta if p3dn reservations are released = +$24k (on-demand + spot mix) but reduces fixed monthly commit by $72k. Confidence: medium (based on 90d usage). Link: https://billing.internal/case/4721
Jihoon Kim: That delta looks acceptable given we rarely hit p3dn peak sustained. Suggest: let p3dn lapse, re-evaluate after 8 weeks. For p4d, propose 75% renewal (convert some to convertible).
Elena Gomez: I'll handle tag cleanup — will create a runbook to ensure we don't orphan commitments.
Ria Patel: Proposal summary: (1) Let p3dn reservations lapse at expiry. (2) Renew p4d at 75% capacity, convert half to convertible reservations. (3) Reconcile tags + reassign any live workloads to remaining reservations. Action owners: Sam (util table, due today), Jihoon (renewal config + cost calc, due in 2 days), Elena (tag runbook, due tomorrow). If no major objections by EOD we'll trigger finance OK flow. :thumbsup:
Sam Turner: Sounds good from me. :+1:
Jihoon Kim: Fine by me, will draft the renewal payload and run a scoped perf test for convertible changes.
Elena Gomez: Will start tag cleanup and post checklist.
Ria Patel: Thanks team — I'll kick off the finance approval ticket once Sam's table is in.
